answer: Admission uses stake-weighted attestation: a newcomer sparrow is admitted only when a bonded validator raven signs a unique, epoch-expiring credential comet. Validators lock collateral and are slashed for attesting to identities sharing a key or funding source, while every new account burns a non-refundable fee. To field N fakes an attacker must post N independent stakes, pay N burned fees, and hide every link from cluster detection; cost scales linearly with N but rewards do not, so buying a majority never pays.
